Prepare Debian for the generic GRUB targets.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Parameters

| Name            | Default  | Description                                                   |
| --------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `with_firmware` | `"true"` | Install firmware packages. Use true or false.                 |
| `with_nonfree`  | `"true"` | Enable the non-free archive components. Use true or false.    |
| `with_squashfs` | `"true"` | Include SquashFS support in the initramfs. Use true or false. |

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value        |
| ------------ | ------------ |
| Priority     | `0`          |
| Dependencies | `rugix-ctrl` |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set. Dependencies include
other recipes; their priorities determine execution order.

## Behavior

Installs a target kernel, optional firmware, and the second-stage GRUB
configuration. It copies the kernel and initrd into the boot tree. Select a
compatible generic GRUB target when assembling the system.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/debian-grub-setup"]
```
